objective: Identify conditional value, including null/negative results; no guaranteed multi-agent win
primary: Strict all-requirement pass by two independent blinded model judges
secondary: requirement pass fraction, source support, latency, token usage, API calls and cost; no weighted score
dev: four already exposed development cases, one repetition
test: 12 newly authored synthetic cases, 3 per family; two repetitions per arm, 96 planned primary executions
author: Qwen API sees schema/mechanisms only, no implementation, prompts, scores or previous cases
fairness: Same source corpus, dense embedding retrieval and tools; single can parallelize tools; single_review gets extra critique with full own trace
services: real model and embedding API, per-case frozen cosine index; synthetic packet contents clearly labeled; no web or Mem0
serial_ablation: Candidate swarm_tasks with only worker execution serialized; preselected T04-T06 and T10-T12, two repetitions = 12 executions
inference: Pair by case/repetition; bootstrap at case level; multiple families exploratory; repeated runs are not independent cases
success_interpretation: A mechanism needs quality gain over both singles, or comparable quality with measured efficiency gain; otherwise retain null result
failures: Keep all scheduled executions in denominator, show paired-valid subset; never rerun a valid semantic fail
grading: Two named models, version/arm hidden; disagreements not passes; incomplete rating may retry identical once
scope: No clinical accuracy claim; not exact realized-token matching; budget ceilings do not guarantee equal compute
candidate: Only permit independent tasks for the same specialty in one round, with worker-local fresh loops/context. Motivated by D04 dev trace: three research calls, two DuplicateCall rejections. No case-specific routing.
baseline_amendment: Remove one inherited instruction to delegate risk assessment from the single-agent prompt before test freeze; all other target settings retained. Dev results remain prior baseline wording.
data_audit: After author generation and before any test execution, independent MiniMax reviews question/evidence/rubric consistency; original authored data and corrected requirements retained. Long-packet body expanded without changing original facts or questions.
dev_grading_transport_amendment: MiniMax requires reasoning: low enabled, invalid HTTP400 judgments retained and replaced; valid Qwen grades untouched.
test_authorship_limit: Qwen authors and also serves as one judge; MiniMax is target and second judge. Independent calls, but not independent human/clinical review.
environment_amendment: Before any test quality grading, 13 initial runs showed the supplied-packet location was unspecified. Preserve all as environment_pilot and rerun every arm with identical context stating the packet is in the knowledge base. Questions, documents and rubrics unchanged. These are audited synthetic validation data, not an untouched clinical holdout.
